tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: rta nag lcags ral can gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

chos dbang gi gter kha'o// ྈྈྈ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo: sngon rgya gar gyi yul du: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas 'gro drug sems can rnams kyi don du byon nas: rgya gar she lo gangs kyi brag phug tu dgongs pa zhag gsum mdzad pas thugs la dgongs pa: sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen 'di rnams 'phral 'byung sla: phugs gso dka': snying ngan la gdug pa che bas ma rungs pa 'di rnams 'dul dgongs nas: dgongs pa btang bas: slob dpon nyid kyi thugs las sprul pa'i sgrub thabs khyad par can gsum mdzad: slob dpon rang nyid khro bor bzhengs pa dang bzhi mdzad: de la slob dpon rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen por khros pa'i sku drag sgrub dang: 'phags pa ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe'i sgrub thabs sku mdog dkar po dang gnyis: phyag na rdo rje gsung gi sgrub thabs sku mdog dmar po la rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros bskor ba dang gsum: rta mgrin nag po rgyal bsen 'dul ba drag po phrin las kyi sgrub thabs dang bzhi'o: de la 'dir ni rta mgrin nag po phrin las kyi sgrub thabs lags so: slob dpon pad+ma lho brag tu byon tsa na: shog dril bzhi bsnams nas brag khro bo rta mgrin gyi mgul par gter du sbas: gter srung btsan gyi rgyal po shwa ba yak+sha me dbal nag po la gtad nas bzhag go: brag rta mgrin gyi mgul nas mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku'i skye ba: slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs kyi sras: gu ru chos dbang gis gter nas gdan drangs pa lags so: rin po che skal ldan yab sras nas rim par brgyud de: de yan chad ni chos la yid ches shing khungs btsun pa brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi tshul bstan pa'o: ༈ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mgrin he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs 'di la don rnam pa bcu gsum gyis bstan te: lha bsgom pa dang gcig:

sngags bzla ba dang gnyis: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs ba la sogs dang gsum: srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bzhi: bum chog dang lnga: rdzas kyis byug bdug bya ba dang drug: rgyal bsen gdug pa can 'dul ba dang bdun: char dbab pa dang brgyad: ser ba srung ba dang dgu: bsad cing mnan pa dang bcu: drag po'i sbyin sreg dang bcu gcig: chung sri 'dul ba dang bcu gnyis: gtor dbang bya ba dang bcu gsum mo: de la dang po lha bsgom pa ni: srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni srung ba'i dus su khro bo rnams sku mdog dkar por bsgom/ g.yas bum pa g.yon 'khor lo'o// bzlog pa dang bsad pa'i dus su nag po/ zhal phyir bsgyur nas mtshon cha bsnams pa/ drag po stong ldan gyi 'khor lo'o// mchan/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid ci yang mi dmigs: cir yang mi rtog pa bde stong gsal la rang bzhin med pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la yun ci ring du lhan ner bzhag go: yang ngag tu dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes brjod pas/ stong pa nyid bde gsal chos nyid kyi chos 'di ma rtogs pa'i sems can: sdang dgra gnod byed dregs pa can 'di rnams snying re rje: 'di rnams kyi don la: dpal rta mgrin nag po chen po 'di bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsam: de nas ngag tu: e dz+nyā na bhan+dha tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: zhes brjod pas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di: keng rus gsar rnying gi dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang chen po zhig bsgom: de'i nang du e las nam mkha' gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba zhig bsgom: de'i nang du klu 'bum gnyan khri: sa bdag stong: phyogs skyong bcu: rgyal chen bzhi: gzhan yang dregs pa bco brgyad: rgyal bsen pho mo rnams phyogs rnams su gan rkyal du bsgyel pa'i steng du:

dri za klu gshin rje gnod sbyin dang bzhi'i thod pa'i mkhar byas pa: lha chen po bzhi'i thod pas mkhar gyi ya thod byas pa: phyogs bzhir ral pa nag po si ler 'phyang ba: de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang rgya che la 'phang mtho ba 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su: sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan: de'i thog tu gnod byed dregs pa can gyi steng du: rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ dmar nag gam: hrīḥ'abar ba 'khrugs pa la nyi zer lta bu'am: skar chen nam: gnam lcags lta bu'i tshwa tshwa khol ba shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhig bsam: de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa': ye shes kyi khro bo dang khro mo: dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs la phog pas: de rnams kyi mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad dus gcig tu 'ub kyis tshur 'dus pas: gong gi hūm̐ ngam hrīḥl phog: de 'od du zhu ba las: bdag nyid dpal rta mgrin nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis: sku mdog mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku: de la dar nag 'jol ber gsol ba: de'i steng du mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa dang: glang chen gyi ko rlon gyis stod g.yogs byas pa: sku smad stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas bsgrad pa: sku yi yan lag bzhi la klu rigs bzhis brgyan pa: dbu la thod skam lnga'i steng du rigs lnga'i he ru ka lnga khros pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa: thod rlon gyis do shal byas pa: smin mtshams su thal chen tshom bu byas pa: zhal la rak+ta'i thig le byas pa: thugs kar zhag gi zo ris byas pa: ba spu'i gseb nas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba: thog dang ser ba khro chung gi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: sku las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba: gnod byed rgyal bsen sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad sreg pa: dbu la gnam lcags kyi ral pa bsigs pa: ral pa'i gseb nas sprul pa'i khro chung grangs med pa 'phros pas:

dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog pa: phyag g.yas ral gri phyar ba'i rtse la me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: g.yon pas lcags kyu thugs kar bsnams nas sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa'i rtse la gnam lcags kyi sdig pa nag po spyang thang tsam gyis gdug pa'i ngar skad 'don pa: gdangs pa'i zhal nas rno ba'i mche ba gtsigs pa: e ā ral+li hring hring pheṃ pheṃ ha ha hi hi'i sgra sgrog pa: zhal gyi sma ra ser po me ltar 'bar ba: shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'bud pa: zhal nas khrag mtsho'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug pa: me stag tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: lcags kyi ral pa kham nag gyen la 'bar ba: thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum gyis dbu brgyan pa'i steng du: 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs pa: dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher ba: rngog ma le brgan bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba: me'i bya khyung dmar po spyi gtsug tu bzhugs pa: gshog pa'i the'u phran thams cad me dpung du 'dug pa: rwa dang mchu sder thams cad gnam lcags su 'dug pa: klu rgyal rigs thams cad zas su za ba: klu 'bum gdan du bting ba: khyung skad nam mkhar 'tsher ba zhig tu bsgom: bdag gi g.yas kyi phyogs su gru gsum dmar nag yangs shing 'jigs su rung ba'i nang du: rgyal bsen pho mo sa bdag klu 'bum bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: khro bo yak+sha me dbal sku mdog dmar po me yi ral pa can: g.yas me'i zhags pa: g.yon tho ba bsnams par bsgom: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon bsgrad pa: sku las rang 'dra'i khro tshogs mang po 'phro ba: gnod byed thams cad brlag cing za bar bsgom: shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhig bsgom: bdag gi g.yon phyogs su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang: dgra bgegs gnod byed bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: gnod sbyin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can: sku mdog mthing nag mon pa'i gzugs su 'dug pa:

g.yas pa lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa: g.yon na me'i lcags kyu bsnams pa: zhabs gnyis bsgrad pa: g.yas na sprul pa'i mon pa bdun rgyug pa: g.yon na shan pa nag po bdun rgyug pa: 'khor du gnod sbyin las mkhan bye ba sa yas bskor ba zhig tu bskyed: dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad brlags nas za bar bsgom: bdag gi mdun na rkang bol steng na lcags kyi sdig pa nag po 'brong chen po khros pa lta bu 'jigs su rung ba: ba spu la sdig pa bye ba 'phro ba: lus la me dpung 'bar ba: rkang lag gis gnam sa gang ba: kha dgu mig dgu bsgrad pa: gnod byed rgyal bsen thams cad brgyal bar byed pa: snying khrag 'jibs shing rtsa rgyus gcod pa zhig bsgom: de'i mdun du phar thad tsam du lcags kyi mi rengs bskyed pa yin: sku'i g.yas su lcags kyi mi rengs nag po g.yas dgra s+t+was dgra bo'i lus srog gcod pa: g.yon sbrul zhags bsnams nas dgra bgegs thams cad bcing bar bsgom: sku'i g.yon du lcags kyi mi rengs nag po phyag g.yas ral gri'i 'khor lo bsnams pas gnod byed thams cad dum bur gtub pa: g.yon pa thod pa gtor mas bkang ba gtso bo la stob pa zhig tu bsgom: sngon rgyab gnyis na zangs kyi mi rengs dmar po gnyis g.yas na lcags kyi ber ka bsnams pas dgra bgegs thams cad brdung bar bsam: g.yon na tsit+ta dmar po bsnams pa gtso bo la stob par bsgom: de thams cad kyang gtum la 'jigs pa: mthong tshad 'dzin pa: zin tshad gsod cing za bar bsgom: stong gsum srid gsum de 'dras mer gyis gang bar bsgom: zhal nas drag sngags si li li bzla bar bsgom: des gsod pa'i dus su rang nyid rta mgrin du bsgom: thugs kar yak+sha me dbal: gnod sbyin lcags ral: lcags kyi mi rengs: zangs kyi mi rengs rnams kyis gsod gcod byed par bsgom: rang nyid rta mgrin du bsgom pa'i lag gi phur pa de/ sku stod khro bo gnod sbyin lcags ral can sku smad phur bu'i gzugs su 'dug pa/

liṅga la phur bu btab pa'i dus su/ dgra bgegs gnod byed bsgral bar bsam/ lcags kyi spyang kis dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi sha zos par bsam/ zangs kyi 'phar bas khrag 'thung bar bsgom/ sprul pa'i khro tshogs rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi sha zos khrag 'thung dngos med du btang bar bsam/ thun gyis brab pa'i dus su nad kyi char sngo dmar dang*/ mtshon gyi char pas dgra bgegs brlag par bsam mo// phyag gi phur bu de sku stod gnod sbyin lcags ral can: sku smad phur bus dgra bgegs thams cad gzir cing bsgral bar bsgom: sprul pa'i phyag chas bcad gtubs za 'thung byed pa de: khro bo zhi sgrub dang 'dra'o: mdun du lcags kyi mi rengs nag po ral pa nag po rked par slebs pa: ral pa'i gseb nas mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phro ba: g.yas zil gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa: sprul pa'i bya khyung pho nyar 'gyed pa: g.yon sbrul zhags bsnams pa: dgra bgegs dru gur 'ching ba: sku rked spu gri'i 'khor lo bskor bas dgra bgegs dum bur gtub pa: lcags spyang pho mo la 'chib par bsgom: lha tshogs de rnams kyang 'jigs su rung ba: dpa' ba: gtum pa: rngams la khro ba: sgeg pa dgod pa: 'bar ba gshe ba: gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa: shin tu drag po'i tshul gyis: stong gsum gyi stong chen po gang bar bsgom mo: de'i rgyab tu ye shes kyi khro bcu srung ba'i dus su sku mdog dkar po: g.yas 'khor lo g.yon bum pa bsnams par bskyed do: zlog pa dang bsad pa'i dus su thams cad mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis: mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams nas zhal phyir bsgyur bas bskor bar bsgom: de'i phyi rol du srung ba'i gur khang bsgom pa ni: gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa: rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa: g.yas su 'khor bas dregs byed pho rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa: g.yon du 'khor bas mo rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa:

dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad dmar myal myal btang bar bsgom mo: de'i rgyab tu gnam lcags rdo rje'i gur khang sra ba: mthug pa: brtan pa: mi chod pa: mi shigs pa: srid pa'i rlung yang mi thar bar bsgom: de'i rgyab tu mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi gur khang so phyi la bstan pa: gang la bya ba tshal pa dum bur btang bar bsam mo: de'i rgyab tu ye shes kyi me ri me dpung dmar nag 'u ru ru 'bar bas: sdang dgra gnod byed byad ma rbod gtong thams cad thal ba rdul du brlags pas: gzhob rag rag bsregs par bsam: de ni srung ba'i gur khang ngo: de nas dbang bskur ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: zhes brjod pas bdag la ye shes rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis dbang bskur bar bsam mo: dug lnga dag nas ye shes lnga'i dbang dang: mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam mo: de nas bdag nyid sngar bas kyang yan lag rags pa: lha tshogs 'di rnams 'od dang 'od zer gyi phung po dang ldan pa: khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol nus pa'i dbang thob par bsam mo: de ni bdag nyid lha bsgom pa dang: bskyed pa'i rim pa dang gzhal yas khang gi rim pa'o: ྈྈྈྈ de nas gnyis pa sngags kyis srung ba lha bsnyen cing sgrub pa ni: thog mar ngag tu: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod pas: bdag nyid gong ltar dpal chen po rta mgrin nag po gzhung ltar bsgoms pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du: yi ge 'khor lo'i dbus su bdag nyid rta mgrin bsgom: thugs kar hrīḥdamar po la bsrung bya bsgom: mdun du nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du bsgom pa gces: hrīḥdamar nag 'od 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa las: rtsa ba'i sngags 'bru bcu po dmar khra ler bskor ba 'od zer dmar nag nyi zer tshwa tshwa lta bu phar 'phros pas: 'gro drug gi sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod: yar 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang:

ye shes kyi lha tshogs thams cad la phog: sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: khro bo rta mgrin la sogs khrag 'thung he ru ka rnams la phog: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad dang: dngos grub kyi bcud thams cad dus gcig la glog 'gyu ba ltar byung ste bdag la phog pas: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bshang gci'i lam du bud nas dag: lus kyi nang thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer gyis mer mer skyil skyil ltem ltem gang bar bsam: bar bar du khro chung gi 'du 'phro dang 'od zer phar 'phros tshur 'dus spro bsdu rgyun ma chad pa rlung gi rta la bskyon par bya'o: de nas nam 'jog pa'i dus su phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur: nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyang 'od zer dmar po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: bdag gi gzhal yas khang la thim: lha rnams bdag gtso bo la thim: gtso bo thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim: sngags phreng hrīḥl thim: hrīḥyang ra btags nas ha la thim: ha gi gu la thim: gi gu rim gyis yal te: bde chen mi rtog stong gsal seng nge: shig ge: 'bol le: rang gsal 'dzin med ma bcos pa: 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod: ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu: da ltar ba yid la mi byed: bzang ngan mi dgag mi sgrub tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad nam mkha' stong pa ltar: gsal stong 'dzin med: rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang la yun ring bar bzhag:

rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo'o: de ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'o: rab zhal mthong: 'bring gsung thos: tha ma'ang me tog dmar po'i gling du phyin pa dang: 'thu ba dang: gos dmar po gyon pa dang: bud med kyis zas mang po ster ba dang: lung ston pa dang: nyi ma shar ba dang: gzhan yang rmi lam bzang po sna tshogs 'byung ngo: gdon thub pa'i rtags dang: stod skyug pa dang: smad bshal ba dang: btsun ba bud med spre'u brdungs pa dang: lha khang mchod rten bsregs pa dang: rang lus la me 'bar bas thams cad bsregs pa rmi'o: de ltar yang dang yang du de ma byung bar bsgrub bo: de ltar gong du rtags byung nas sham bu btags pa ni: bdag nyid gong ltar rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro chung mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas nad dug gi rlangs pa spu gri lta bus: gnod byed gang yin tshal pa dum bur phye mar byas nas: las mkhan rnams kyis dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi sha zos khrag 'thung: rus pa 'chos nas thal ba'i rdul du brlags par bsam mo: rtsa ba'i sngags la 'di sbrel: yak+sha nag pos gnod byed pho mo'i srog rtsa la rbad rbad: srog la rbad rbad: snying rtsa la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gyi yid la rbad rbad: yak+sha kā la chen pos sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gyi tsit+ta zung zung: tsit+ta shig shig: tsit+ta rmugs rmugs: tsit+ta phyungs phyungs: tsit+ta gtubs gtubs: tsit+ta myog myog: tsit+ta thuṃ thuṃ: ril ril rbad rbad: ya ya bh+yo bh+yo: srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa phyungs phyungs: gtubs gtubs khaṃ khaṃ: rbad rbad: dum bur rbud rbud: nā ga rā tsa mā ra ya rbad sod: myog baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad rbad: de ni sngags kyi rim pa'o/ de ltar rdzas dang sngags dang ting 'dzin gsum byas pas: rtags ni lus la na tsha sna tshogs 'byung ngo: de'i dus su sngags la brtson 'grus drag po bskyed nas bzla'o:

des sbal sbrul la sogs khyi phag bya sprel byi la : sems can gdug pas so 'debs pa'i dus sngags la: gong ltar thub rtags ma byung bar bzla'o: bar bar du byams snying rje drag po gding nas bskyed do: gdon dang gdon sa gnod byed gsum rnams stong par brtags la: ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag go: de ltar byas pas rang gi lus la na tsha gang gis kyang mi tshugs so: dper na rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa dang 'dra'o: lcags bsregs la sbrang bu babs pa dang 'dra'o: phyis kyang zlog mi srid do: 'di shin tu zab la gnyan zhing sdig che bas gsang ngo: dam med la ma spel cig: gal te re re la spel na yang bka' rgya dam par bya'o: dbang bskur byas la gsang bar dam bca' 'o: de ltar byas pas phrin las rnams lhun gyis grub pas: dgra bgegs rnam gnyis dus gcig tu bsgral nas: phyi mar pad+ma dbang gi sa thob nas: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈ de nas dam tshig sems dpa'i bskyed rim gsal bar bsgom: gsum pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang ba ni 'di skad do// hrī: stong nyid dbang drag chos dbyings dkyil 'khor nas: keng rus gsar rnying gcal bkram dur khrod nas: drag po e yi gzhal yas chen po'i nang: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag bye ba stong: rgyal chen sde bzhi lha chen klu chen brgyad: phyogs skyong bcu dang gza' dang rgyu skar dang: dregs byed lha srin sde brgyad thod pa'i mkhar: sna tshogs pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i khri: gnod byed pho mo dregs byed bco brgyad steng: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: ye shes khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: gtum chen rab 'bar ha ya grī wa'i sku: gar gyi dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ka: sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid 'gyur ba med: lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: rta gdong zhal gyi phyag rgyas spyan 'dren na:

phrin las myur mgyogs gar yang thogs pa med: dbang gi rta skad 'tsher zhing gshegs su gsol: chos dbyings dbang drag rab 'jigs pho brang nas: dpal chen rta mgrin nag po gshegs su gsol: spyi gtsug nam mkha' yangs pa'i da la nas: dpal chen gsung sprul khyung chen ga ru ḍa: rigs lnga sprul pa'i bya khyung 'khor dang bcas: sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gru gsum dmar nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: dbang chen sku sprul yak+sha me dbal sku: sprul pa'i khro tshogs bye ba 'khor dang bcas: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: rta mchog thugs sprul gnod sbyin lcags ral can: gnod sbyin mon pa shan pa 'khor dang bcas: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: 'jigs pa'i gzugs sprul sdig pa gshegs su gsol: dpal chen rta mgrin nag po'i lha tshogs rnams: stong gsum dregs byed 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: srog bdag rgyal 'gong 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: 'jig rten lha 'dre 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gnod byed rgyal bsen 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: thams cad ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa e h+ye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: e ā ral+li hring hring sa ma ya dza dza: ces brjod pas dpal rta mgrin nag po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dran nas/ bdag nyid kyis phrin las gang bcol mdzad pa'i phyir/ skad cig tsam la mdun gyi nam mkhar bya khyu thang la babs pa ltar/ dbang drag gi las la thib thib shar shar sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas byon par bsam mo// de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hrī: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dur khrod rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i pho brang dbus: dregs chen ma traṃ bsgral pa'i gdan steng na:

drag po khro chen tsit+ta'i gzhal yas dang: thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan steng na: lha bdud pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: dpal chen rta mgrin nag po bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: mkha' lding khyung chen rgyal po bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa'i gdan steng du: sprul sku yak+sha me dbal bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: thugs sprul gnod sbyin nag po bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla lcags spyang pho mo'i steng: gsang mtshan gshin rje nag po bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla klu gnyan gdan steng du: las mkhan lcags sdig nag po bzhugs su gsol: dpal chen rta mgrin nag po'i lha tshogs rnams: gdug pa 'dul phyir gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa gri ni pad+ma ka ma la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ bdag dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa la dgongs nas/ brtan cing mi g.yo bar bzhugs par bsgom mo// de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrī: rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas: dbang drag mthar phyin khro rgyal rta mchog dpal: che btsan dpe bral khams gsum 'gran zla med: sku mdog mthing nag rab brjid 'jigs pa'i gzugs: phyag gnyis gdug pa'i mtshon chas dgra bgegs sgrol: rta mgrin nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum dbang sdud sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: srid gsum zil gyis gnon la phyag= dbang drag lhun gyis grub la phyag= dregs pa dgra bgegs 'dul la phyag= gdug pa'i klu gnyan ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: gsung sprul ga ru ḍa la phyag= gdug pa'i dgra bgegs dregs chen 'dul ba'i phyir: yak+sha me dbal sku la phyag= gnod byed 'byung po ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: gnod sbyin lcags ral can la phyag= sdang ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: gsang mtshan gshin nag sku la phyag= rgyal bsen 'byung po sa bdag 'dul ba'i phyir:

lcags sdig las mkhan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: dam can bka' srung tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa sa ma ya yak+sha kā la e h+ye hi a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: ces brjod pas bdag dam tshig sems dpa' dang*/ lha ye shes sems dpa' gnyis med du phyag 'tshal bar bsam mo// de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bdag gong ltar du gyur pa'i thugs ka nas/ 1$0000250raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 1$0000300 gis gtor ma bsreg sbyang bya/ 1$0000250mdun gyi gtor ma de snod bhan+dha rgya che la 'phang mtho ba/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'di dang mnyam pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ bcud sha khrag gi phung po ri rab dang mnyam pa/ lbu ba ri rab dang mnyam pa/ dregs byed dgra bgegs gang gnod pa thams cad dang*/ bsgrub bya'i sha khrag tu dmigs 1$0000300 la 'bul lo// 1$0000250gzhan yang gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa/ nam mkha'i skar tshogs dang bar snang gi sprin phung*/ sa gzhi'i sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal tsam du byin gyis brlabs 1$0000300 la 'bul lo// de yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyi 1$0000250dang pos stong par sbyang*/ gnyis pas bsam gyis mi khyab par spel/ gsum pas lha tshogs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyes nas/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rnams/ rkan sgra dang bcas pas gsol bar 1$0000300 bsam mo// 1$0000250bdag gi phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ sdang gdug gnyis dus gcig la bsgral bar 1$0000300 bsam/ rtsa sngags gsham la i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi:

dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la kha kha khā hi: i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi: zhes brjod pas 'bul lo// gzhan yang lha tshogs rkang 'thon tshig gis 'bul lo// de nas bdag nyid ting nge 'dzin gsal bar byas la 'di skad do// hrī: dbang phyug lhun grub 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: khams gsum dbang sdud khro rgyal rta mchog dpal: gar mkhan bsgyur 'dra'i pad+ma he ru ka: sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid don dang ldan: phyag g.yas gdug pa'i mtshon chas dgra bgegs sgrol: g.yon pa'i lcags kyus dam nyams snying nas 'dren: dur khrod chas brgyad 'bar bas sku la brgyan: khro bo'i bzhin rngam lcang lo ral pa can: sprul pa'i khro bo nyis stong sku la 'phro: ye shes khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po la: dam rdzas sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang: dug lnga sman bsgyur pañtsa a mṛ ta: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon tshogs dang bcas: dgra bgegs don snying dbang po rnam lnga dang: khams gsum yongs sgrol sha khrag rgya mtshor bcas: tan gan sbyor sgrol la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas: ting 'dzin yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin nag po'i lha tshogs dang: dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams la 'bul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnam gnyis dang: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: dpal chen gsung sprul khyung chen ga ru ḍa: gdug pa'i klu 'dul bya khyung rgyal po la: dam rdzas sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul: gdug pa klu gnyan 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dpal chen gsung sprul dgra bgegs yongs kyi gshed: 'jigs byed khro rgyal yak+sha me dbal la: dam rdzas sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs sprul dregs chen gnod byed gshed: gnod sbyin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can: dam rdzas sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul:

gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol: dpal gyi bka' sdod gsang mtshan gshed nag po: dam rdzas sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul: gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol: dpal chen bka' sdod 'jig rten dregs pa'i gshed: 'jigs pa'i gzugs sprul sdig pa nag po la: dam rdzas sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul: sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan dam can srung ma'i tshogs: bstan pa srung mdzad chos skyong srung ma la: dam rdzas sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul: bstan pa'i dgra bo sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa pad+ma ga ru ḍa: yak+sha kā la rū pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: ar+ghaṃ: puṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: ghan+dhe: nai wid+ya: shab+da pū dza āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa: ma hā rak+ta: ma hā tsit+ta: ba su ta: go ro tsa na: kiṃ ni ri ti a mṛta i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi sha khrag la khā hi: zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha tshogs rnams kyi gtor sngags dang*/ tshigs bcad kyis rkang 'thon brjod/ phrin las gang sgrub kyi don la gsol ba btab la 'bul lo// de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas nas: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma dregs pa'i steng: gtum chen rab 'bar khro bo kun gyi rje: gsung gi dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ka: chos sku 'gyur med khro rgyal rta mchog dpal: chos dbyings mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing nag la: skye med ngang las dbang drag zhal gdangs rngams: 'jigs byed lcags kyi ral pa gyen thur bshal: sku gsum don ldan spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: gzhan las khyad 'phags rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: thal chen rak+ta zhag gi zo ris mtshan: glang chen ko rlon stag sham sbrul chun brjid: thod pa skam rlon do shal mgul chur ldan:

phyag g.yas ral gris dregs pa'i srog rtsa gcod: g.yon pa'i lcags kyus gdon bgegs snying nas 'dren: sdig pa nag pos ma rungs snying khrag 'jib: stong gsum rab sdud dar nag ber chen gsol: 'bar ba'i gar dgu dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: tsham rngam brkyang bskum zhabs gnyis dgra bgegs gnon: me ri me dpung gnod byed thams cad sreg: tshangs pa'i gsung gis thams cad dbang du sdud: drag po kun sgrol srid gsum zil gyis gnon: khams gsum dbang sdud rta mgrin rgyal po'i sku: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa bsam mi khyab: sprul pa'i khyung chen spyi gtsug khra thabs 'gyed: yak+sha me dbal g.yas su khra thabs 'gyed: sprul pa'i khro chung dpag med khra thabs 'gyed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis: phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu sprul pa 'gyed: dbang chen khrag 'thung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang chen khro mchog gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs mchog ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes lha tshogs 'phro la phyag= phrin las phyogs bcur khyab la phyag= bdud dpung zil gyis gnon la phyag= che btsan 'gran zla med la phyag= dbang drag kun 'dus khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: thams cad lhun gyis grub la phyag 'tshal bstod: dregs pa rtsad nas gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma rungs gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: thams cad kun sgrol khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hring hring hring: ha ha ha: ho ho hoḥ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sa ma ya dzaḥdza:

zangs lcags dug gsum gyi thun gyis liṅga brab bo: thub pa'i rtags ni: khyi dang bu chung rmang rtse sre mo bsad bcad byas pa rmis na thub pa'i rtags yin: de ltar byung na rten rab gnas can gyi 'og tu mnan: dgra bgegs gnod byed gang yin yang: las mtha' brtul ba'i las yin pas: re bas btums la yug sa'i skra shad kyis rgya gram du bcing: mchod rten rab gnas can gyi zhabs su mnan: bdag nyid dpal chen rta mgrin du bsgoms pas las bzhi'i bro brdung: ri rab chen po'i 'og tu gnod byed gang yin de bskal pa grangs med du yang mi ldang bar bsam mo: de yi rjes la mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab bo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ bcu gsum pa dpal rta mgrin nag po'i sgo nas gtor dbang byed par 'dod pas: gdan pad zla'i steng du rta mgrin lha tshogs su bsgom: mdun du phyag na rdo rje gtum po bsgom: g.yas su yak+sha me dbal: g.yon du gnod sbyin nag po: rgyab tu 'jam dpal: dbus su pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog mthing nag: de rnams gtor ma la bskyed la spyan 'dren la sogs pa bya: gtor ma slob ma'i mgor bzung la: spro bsdu bskyed bstim legs par dmigs pa gtad: bstod pa dang gsol ba gdab: ci 'dod khams dang bstun pa bya: gtor dbang tshar ba dang lha tshogs rnams gtor ma dang: bdag la tshur bstim: gtor ma'i phud lha tshogs la mchod nas: lhag ma dngos grub tu longs spyod: slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga'o: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: dregs pa can bco brgyad kha phyur ba'i dus su gzhan gang gis kyang mi thub pas: shin tu rno la myur ba'i dregs pa can ma rungs pa rnams skad cig la brlag par byed pa: pad+ma dbang chen dregs pa srog gcod kyi nang nas bsdus pa: rta mgrin nag po 'di phyi rabs kyi don du brag khro bo rta mgrin gyi mgul par gter du sbas:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: phyis gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis gter nas gdan drangs pa'o// las can re re la ma gtogs gzhan la mi spel bar bya'o// shin tu dam par bka' rgya'o// u pa dhe sha pra dz+nyā ha ya grī wa gho ra ta u pa rgya/ thaṃ thaṃ/ ༈ bud med la chung sri zhugs nas sgab mi 'phel ba la 'di ltar bya'o// phung shul gyi sa la thun khung gru gsum pa zhig byas la: gro ga la tsakra rtsibs bzhi pa zhig byas lte ba la gang gnod pa'i liṅga ming byang bri: rtsibs bzhi la rtsa sngags bri: mu khyud la sngags ring bri: tha ma me ris bskor ba bri: de dril la byi la nag po'i thod par bcug: yug sa mo'i zhabs mas gtum: de thun khung nang du bcug: khyi spu ra bal gyi skud pas bcing: yug sa mo'i skra shad kyi skud pas gzungs thag bya: ting 'dzin ni bdag yi dam du bsgom: gzungs thag la 'od zer tshur bsdu: phar la dug dang mtshon gyi char spro: gang gnod pa'i steng du me yi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa zhig bskor: thun khung nang du gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa zhig g.yas su bskor: 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du bsad bcad gtubs par bsam: thub pa'i mtshan ma ni: khyi gu nag po dang li li nag po dang: bu chung sre mo bsad pa dang: bzung ba thub rtags yin pas: bdug pa byas te lha dang dbye: sa'i ga'u'i nang du bcug ste: lha khang ngam mchod rten nam: sāts+tsha rab gnas can gyi zhabs su sba: thag pa nag pos rgya gram du bcings so: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis phyi rabs ban dhe 'bong chung gi don du mdzad pa rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
